goal: Verify that the P2 build cache carry satisfies its requirements on the exact fixed Snapshot.

deliverables: Build on the existing safe cache path, not beside it: the shared OptimizationEnvironment for code Tasks, the .af-cache sandbox layout, review-sandbox's materialize_cache and remove_materialized_caches, CacheManifest@1 and TaskRuntimeEvidence@1 cache spans (see docs/task-execution/self-optimizer.md and crates/review-pipeline/src/task/optimization.rs). Do not add a second cache mechanism or a second selection file.

review.kernel/BuildCache@1: a candidate-built artifact captured from the Gate's declared cache directories after its check Attempt on the head, with producer and head provenance, regular-file-only layout, descriptor-relative no-follow traversal, entry, depth, path and byte limits, fixed modes, xattrs and ACLs stripped; explicitly unsafe, never typed, named or documented as a Cache Snapshot
A closed cargo_target cache kind that points CARGO_TARGET_DIR at the sandbox-local clone; the registry-only Cargo snapshot keeps its existing meaning
Typed Gate-to-Worker handoff of the BuildCache within one Round for Worker sandboxes that declare the kind; refused before any Worker dispatch under the safe policy; admitted only under trusted_local
Cache bytes removed before seal so they never enter a candidate tree, Proposal or delivered worktree
BuildCacheCaptured@1 event with gate attempt, head snapshot, entries, bytes and the limits applied; the Warm Set records the carried build cache
Schemas, parity fixtures, one ADR numbered after the latest, README index entry, CHANGELOG Unreleased entry
acceptance: A safe pipeline refuses the handoff before any Worker dispatch
A symlink, FIFO or special file in the Gate's cache directory refuses capture with a recorded reason
A TDD reviewer fixture reuses the Gate build and its sealed diff is byte-identical to a cold run
The existing self-optimizer cache fixtures and review-sandbox cache tests keep passing unchanged
